tests.intent: Prevents App pages from losing sandbox/runtime boundaries, bounded offline package restore, accepted entries or drafts during late live refresh, explicit source reconciliation, or recovery access.

tests.name: SN-135 immersive PDF reader
tests.intent: Guards the immersive PDF attachment reader across desktop and mobile, including full-viewport launch, no horizontal clipping, collapsible mobile chrome, remembered last-read page, the SN-138 navigation bar with direct page-jump input, and SN-136 Annotate mode (ink + highlight tools, annotate-off gesture restore, sidecar persistence without mutating PDF bytes).
tests.whenToRun: Pre-merge when touching PDF attachments, the rich-text attachment launch path, EmbedPDF integration, annotation sidecar persistence, the reader navigation bar / page-jump control, or reader state persistence.
tests.failureMeaning: PDF attachments may reopen the old cramped preview path, clip document pages, lose mobile reading area, break the page-jump control, fail to restore the reader position, leave Annotate controls flash-disabled, or lose ink/highlight sidecar data.

tests.name: SN-136 PDF annotation walkthrough
tests.intent: Protects the complete researcher annotation journey with real document gestures and visual evidence: quiet highlight creation, comment authoring and read-mode reopen, outside-tap dismissal, ink authoring, and direct eraser scrub on desktop and mobile.
tests.whenToRun: Pre-merge when changing the immersive PDF reader annotation toolbar, pointer routing, highlight comments, annotation persistence, or eraser interaction.
tests.failureMeaning: The PDF annotation journey may have regained interaction friction, intrusive highlight UI, broken comment access or dismissal, incorrect pointer routing, or nonfunctional ink erasing.

tests.name: SN-151 large PDF first paint
tests.description: Production-bundle Playwright: e2e/sn-151-large-pdf-paint.spec.ts via playwright.sn151.config.ts — Deep Learning book paints real tiles after pager is live; ResizeObserver-miss case covered.
tests.intent: Guards in-app first paint for a real 600+ page vault PDF when the viewport ResizeObserver delivery is missed — the gray-frame failure mode that stock EmbedPDF Scroller hits.
tests.whenToRun: Pre-merge when touching immersive-pdf-reader scroller/zoom-gate/tiling, PDF vault cache, or EmbedPDF plugin wiring.
tests.failureMeaning: Large PDFs may show a live pager with zero painted tiles (permanent gray) or snap zoom incorrectly after open.

tests.name: SN-151 PDF open timing (cold/warm)
tests.description: Production-bundle Playwright: e2e/sn-151-open-timing.spec.ts via playwright.sn151timing.config.ts — click→first paint budgets for cold and warm reopen.
tests.intent: Protects warm reopen well under 5s (session engine + vault PDF cache) and keeps cold open dominated by network rather than main-thread stalls.
tests.whenToRun: Pre-merge when changing PDFium engine lifecycle, pdf-vault-cache, Reload-app cache policy, or reader mount sequencing.
tests.failureMeaning: Reopening a large PDF may again cold-start WASM or re-download the full binary, restoring minute-scale open times.

tests.name: SN-151 PDF responsive open (desktop+mobile)
tests.description: Production-bundle Playwright: e2e/sn-151-responsive-open.spec.ts via playwright.sn151resp.config.ts — no long main-thread tasks, scroll stays live, all visible pages paint, toolbar survives, warm reopen under budget. Uses real annotation sidecar.
tests.intent: Guards the frozen-UI / blank-sibling-pages / vanishing-toolbar failure caused by importing bloated native-LINK sidecars or other long main-thread work during open and scroll.
tests.whenToRun: Pre-merge when touching PDF annotation import/export filtering, chunked import, immersive reader open path, or annotation sidecar schema.
tests.failureMeaning: Opening or reopening a book with annotations may freeze the UI for tens of seconds, leave pages blank, break scroll, or drop the toolbar after paint settles.
tests.maintenanceNotes: Requires the Deep Learning vault PDF plus its annotations sidecar under vault/AI/Learning/. Not part of default playwright.config.ts (testIgnore sn-151-*).

tests.name: PDF annotation sidecar filter
tests.description: Jest: tests/pdf-annotations.test.ts — user-authored ink/highlight filter, parse/build, companion summary.
tests.intent: Ensures native PDF LINK/widget annotations never enter the EmbedPDF sidecar and that ink/highlight round-trips stay intact.
tests.whenToRun: Pre-merge when changing pdf-annotations helpers or /api/pdf-annotations sanitization.
tests.failureMeaning: Sidecars may again absorb thousands of native links and freeze every large-PDF reopen, or drop real user ink/highlights.

tests.name: PDF vault Cache Storage
tests.description: Jest: tests/pdf-vault-cache.test.ts and tests/pdf-reader-session.test.ts — v4 validation, session buffer, retained reader, deferred revalidation.
tests.intent: Protects Local-copy reopen integrity (%PDF + %%EOF), same-tab session buffers, one-PDF retained reader reuse, and deferred background revalidation that must not starve first paint.
tests.whenToRun: Pre-merge when changing pdf-vault-cache, retained PDF reader sessions, or Reload-app PDF cache policy.
tests.failureMeaning: Large PDF reopens may serve truncated Local copies (gray forever), remount after leaving the reader, or compete with paint via eager revalidation.

tests.name: PWA Reload preserves PDF cache
tests.description: Jest: tests/pwa-service-worker.test.ts — FORCE_RELOAD clears app shell only, not vault PDF buckets.
tests.intent: Guarantees Settings → Reload app refreshes the app shell without wiping smart-notes-vault-pdfs-* Cache Storage.
tests.whenToRun: Pre-merge when changing service-worker FORCE_RELOAD handling or sw-update triggerForceReload.
tests.failureMeaning: Every Reload app would force a full re-download of large PDFs and recreate minute-scale reopen times.

tests.name: Jupyter Inline AI Fast Lane
tests.description: Jest: tests/jupyter-fast-lane.test.ts + tests/jupyter-fast-lane-route.test.ts + tests/jupyter-focus-context.test.tsx — SN-247 warm/resumed no-tools Claude session lifecycle, provider argument construction (resume, small model, low effort, empty tool list, isolated cwd), lane-scoped policy isolation from the companion, the companion fast-lane API routes, and (SN-253) opt-in token streaming — --include-partial-messages only when a caller passes onText, stream_event text_delta accumulation, and no answer doubling when the assembled assistant message follows its own deltas.
tests.intent: Guards the warm/resumed Claude fast-lane session used for low-latency Jupyter inline AI: session id capture from the first stream event, --resume instead of re-sending the system prompt, empty --tools= tool list, smallest-model/low-effort lane policy kept independent of the companion provider selection, graceful fallback when warm-up has not landed yet, and no orphaned child process on cancel/timeout/close.
tests.whenToRun: Pre-merge when touching packages/cli-chat/fast-lane.js, packages/cli-chat/sandbox.js claudeSandboxArgs, src/server/ai/jupyter-fast-lane.ts, the companion fast-lane API routes, or the Jupyter page open/close lifecycle in jupyter-notebook-view.tsx.
tests.failureMeaning: A failure here means resumed fast-lane turns may silently fall back to full cold turns (losing the <=3s TTFT target), the no-tools sandbox guarantee may leak the full tool list to the model, or a cancelled/failed/timed-out turn may leave an orphaned claude.exe process running against a closed Jupyter page.
tests.maintenanceNotes: The lifecycle suite spawns a scripted fake claude CLI (tests/fixtures/fake-claude.cmd/.js) instead of the real CLI — no network access or API cost, fully deterministic. The turn-timeout test genuinely waits out TURN_TIMEOUT_MS (20s), which is why this entry is tagged cost=slow.

tests.name: SN-249 Jupyter Inline AI Overlay
tests.description: Jest: tests/jupyter-inline-ai.test.tsx + tests/ai-sidebar-pdf-shell.test.tsx — selection and explicit Alt+Right-click action-list construction (Explain/Ask/Fix/Rewrite plus comment-to-code/comment-answer), bare-caret silence on natural-language comments and markdown headings, Explain-renders-in-overlay vs write-to-notebook routing, one apply-answer bridge call per write action, protected notebook-routed streaming/apply and sticky Retry states, independent fast-lane provider/model settings, hardened no-chat Fix/Rewrite behavior, Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+Enter comment append, and Answer comment preserving the original comment line while streaming the turn.
tests.intent: Guards the Jupyter inline-AI invocation contract: text selection shows Explain/Ask/Fix/Rewrite; bare caret focus stays quiet even when comment detection matches; explicit Alt+Right-click opens the menu and adds Write code / Answer comment on a matching comment; plain right-click remains JupyterLab-owned; Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+Enter appends generated code below a matching comment; and notebook-routed writes survive passive dismissal until one undo-grouped bridge operation succeeds or a sticky Retry error is explicitly closed.
tests.whenToRun: Pre-merge when touching src/lib/jupyter-inline-ai.ts, the inline overlay in src/components/jupyter-notebook-view.tsx, the fast-lane settings section of src/components/ai-sidebar.tsx, or src/lib/jupyter-focus.ts's dismiss/apply-answer/keybinding message contracts.
tests.failureMeaning: A failure here means a bare caret click may reopen the overlay, selection or explicit Alt+Right-click actions may be missing, comment-only actions may appear on the wrong trigger, plain right-click may steal JupyterLab's menu, passive selection/scroll events may discard an in-flight cell rewrite, the append chord may replace rather than preserve the comment, or an inline result may route to the wrong surface or undo boundary.
tests.maintenanceNotes: SN-264 made bare caret focus quiet and moved comment actions behind explicit Alt+Right-click while retaining selection and append-chord behavior. SN-265 protects notebook-routed streaming/apply and sticky Retry states from passive selection-clear and scroll dismissal.
